//: Type-checks the extension source without turning it into TypeScript. There
is no build step and no emit: `npm run typecheck` is a gate, not a compiler.
lines of plain JS they produce thousands of 'parameter implicitly has an
any type' notes that bury the diagnostics worth acting on (misspelled
properties, wrong arity, unreachable branches, unused bindings).
Node types are deliberately absent here: extension code runs in a browser,
and loading them makes setTimeout return a Node Timeout. Build and test
scripts are checked separately by jsconfig.scripts.json.
